I'm Justin. I spent about four years in quant trading and research, most recently at a crypto trading firm, and I'm now working on post-training, evals, and agents.

This site is mostly for me: writing things out is how I find where my understanding is thin. Posts are written in the open and revised when I learn I was wrong.

**Projects**

- [proactive-memory-bench](https://github.com/jpei33/proactive-memory-bench) — memory strategies for proactive agents in team chat
- [reward-hacking-generalization](https://github.com/jpei33/reward-hacking-generalization) — does SFT on shortcut-taking generalize to other constraint violations?
- steerable-intervention — distilling a small model for the when-to-speak decision
- [lm-reflection-credit](https://github.com/jpei33/lm-reflection-credit) — are LLM reflection gains search-limited or capability-limited?
